pairing.title: Pair the cuff on the host
pairing.description:
The 6-digit PIN is OS Bluetooth pairing, not a Home Assistant prompt.

1. Press **User 1** or **User 2** on the cuff so Bluetooth flashes (about 2 minutes). A new measurement is not required.
2. Unpair the cuff from medi.connect and any phone. Only one client should hold the bond.
3. On the Home Assistant host (SSH / Terminal add-on), run `bluetoothctl`, then `scan on`, `pair {address}`, enter the PIN shown on the cuff, and `trust {address}`.
4. ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy cannot pair this cuff (no PIN UI) and is unsupported.

If advertising stops, press User 1 or User 2 again and retry `pair`.

user_slot.title: Which user?
user_slot.description:
Choose the cuff memory slot this Home Assistant device should publish (**User 1** or **User 2**, same labels as the buttons). The GATT dump may still contain both slots; only the newest timestamp for this slot is used.

A second person can add the same cuff later and pick the other user.
